gauge_sensitivity_note: Both initial and terminal factors are transformed. H-row values re-evaluate W-column stopping points; no H-row stopping experiment or alternative algorithm ranking is claimed.
matched_objective_note: Each target is the median terminal MU objective for that setting. Counts include all five runs; medians include only runs reaching the target at a saved checkpoint. Checkpoints are ten sweeps apart. Timing values come from the original runs, not these diagnostic reruns.
